焊膏印刷设备及工艺参数应满足以下要求：

a) 采用自动或半自动印刷机通过印刷模板将焊膏漏印至连接盘区域。

b) 印刷设备应满足以下要求：

1) 具备良好的定位精度与重复精度，能保证印刷模板与连接盘精确对位；

2） 具备夹板系统及支撑系统，印刷时PCB应能固定，并与印刷模板紧密接触，PCB底部需
有足够的支撑，防止印刷时变形；

3) 刮刀压力与移动速度可根据要求进行调节；

4) 能控制印刷模板与PCB之间的分离过程及分离距离，并能对印刷后的模板进行擦拭，以
防堵塞模板网孔。

c) 印刷宜采用金属模板，开口应满足以下要求：

1) 孔的宽度(W)与模板厚度(T)之比大于1.5;

2) 孔开口面积(W×L)与孔壁面积(2(W+L)×T)之比大于0.66;

补偿；

宜不小于3.75mm;

时，宜使用纳米处理金属模板。

0.510.65 | 0.15~0.18
0.4<P1≤0.5 | 0.8<P2≤1.0 | 0.12~0.15
0.3<P1≤0.4 | 0.5<P2≤0.8 | 0.10~0.12

0.4N/mm，刮刀速度宜为20mm/s~50mm/s，模板上焊膏的滚动直径宜为15mm~25mm。

Component Lift

In most cases component lifting during reflow would be blamed on the reflow process. However,in this case a combination of stencil and pad design have caused the component to lift on the solder as it reflows forming a bump. The pad width is wider than the gap in the plastic standoff body of the component. The incorrect pad design has been used on this part, leading to a wider stencil

aperture. To be fair there may have been a change
in the component supplier but if that is the case the new part should have been checked with the board design before accepting new stock. Alternatively the engineer should have reduced the stencil width and increased its length to maintain paste volume for the joint but not lifted the part.

Component Lift

In most cases component lifting during reflow would be blamed on the reflow process. However,in this case a combination of stencil and pad design have caused the component to lift on the solder as it reflows forming a bump. The pad width is wider than the gap in the plastic standoff body of the component. The incorrect pad design has been used on this part, leading to a wider stencil

aperture. To be fair there may have been a change
in the component supplier but if that is the case the new part should have been checked with the board design before accepting new stock. Alternatively the engineer should have reduced the stencil width and increased its length to maintain paste volume for the joint but not lifted the part.

防堵塞模板网孔。

In most cases component lifting during reflow would be blamed on the reflow process.
